title: Warm Spicy Malaysian Monkfish Curry
description: A mustardy and indulgent Malaysian curry featuring monkfish, cooked in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot for a unique flavor and texture, low in sodium for a healthier option.
instructions: Heat the ghee or oil in the ttukbaegi earthenware pot over medium heat.
Add the mustard seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to brown.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the curry powder and salt-free seasoning blend and stir for a minute.
Add the monkfish pieces and cook until they are opaque and firm to the touch.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the curry simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
